question: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
solution:
The correct answer is, '**Vitamin A - Lamb liver'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Lamb liver **is rich in two forms of Vitamin A: **Preformed A and Carotene**.
 
• Vitamin A plays an important role in** maintaining the health of the skin and eyes.**
 
• **Milk, eggs, and tomatoes** are some of the most common sources of Vitamin A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Vitamin A - Lemon** is incorrect. **Lemon is a good source of Vitamin C**.

 
 
• **Citrus, strawberries, and bell peppers** are some of the most common sources of Vitamin C.
 
 
 
• **Vitamin B - Lemon** is incorrect.
 
 
• **Leafy green vegetables, chicken and turkey, and sunflower seeds** are the most common sources of Vitamin B.
 
 
 
• **Vitamin C - Green vegetables** is incorrect.
 
 
• Green vegetables are a good source of Vitamin B and Vitamin K.
